notes.title: Developer's note.
notes.content:
Dear players,

Doctor Tsunami is brought to you by a very small team of two individuals, dedicated to bring you this very large and complex game. 

We are aware that there may be bugs in this earliest of versions, and are committed to resolving them as soon as we can. 

Therefore, we ask that you please avoid posting negative reviews if you come across any issues. Bad reviews will hurt sales and could seriously reduce our capability of providing the support we know you deserve.

Instead, you may help us by letting us know about it in our forums: 
[url=https://www.doctor-tsunami.com/forum]https://www.doctor-tsunami.com/forum[/url]

We deeply appreciate your cooperation and welcome you to our community. 


Our sincere thanks.   


Rob and Will, the Doctor Tsunami team.
